title: Restore Us, O God

questions.question: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:1 (ESV): "Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock."

questions.question: You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:1 (ESV): "You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth."

questions.question: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might and come to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:2 (ESV): "...stir up your might and come to save us!"

questions.question: Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:3 (ESV): "Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved!"

questions.question: O Lord God of hosts, how long will you be angry with your people's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:4 (ESV): "...how long will you be angry with your people's prayers?"

questions.question: You have fed them with the bread of tears and given them tears to drink in full what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:5 (ESV): "...and given them tears to drink in full measure."

questions.question: You make us an object of contention for our neighbors, and our enemies laugh among whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:6 (ESV): "...and our enemies laugh among themselves."

questions.question: You brought a vine out of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:8 (ESV): "You brought a vine out of Egypt;"

questions.question: You drove out the nations and planted what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:8 (ESV): "you drove out the nations and planted it."

questions.question: You cleared the ground for it; it took deep root and filled the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:9 (ESV): "You cleared the ground for it; it took deep root and filled the land."

questions.question: Why then have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass along the way pluck its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:12 (ESV): "...so that all who pass along the way pluck its fruit?"

questions.question: The boar from the forest ravages it, and all that move in the field do what on it?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:13 (ESV): "...and all that move in the field feed on it."

questions.question: Turn again, O God of hosts! Look down from heaven, and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:14 (ESV): "Turn again, O God of hosts! Look down from heaven, and see;"

questions.question: Have regard for this vine, the stock that your right hand planted, and for the son whom you made strong for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:15 (ESV): "...and for the son whom you made strong for yourself."

questions.question: But let your hand be on the man of your right hand, the son of man whom you made strong for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 80:17 (ESV): "...the son of man whom you made strong for yourself."

key_verse_text: Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved!
